stories.text: 🚨 RULED OUT: E. Egbuka won't play, and he's in Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy's starting lineup. Kickoff's Sunday 1 PM. Clock's ticking.
⚡ Early edge: Brock You Like a Hurricane went from 70% to 95% against Mr. Action Jackson, led by Maye (28.44 pts).
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 29.7 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: PIT VS NO (Sunday 9:30 AM), 13 league starters in action with 160.69 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Sunday 9:30 AM (PIT VS NO): 13 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Kyle Tucker vs The Mahomies (36.78 pts projected).
🗓️ Sunday's key matchup: TDsMaGee 52% vs Claremont In Yo Stace!. Watch Williams (20.66 pts) vs Murray (18.24 pts).
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: In My Fantasy Era leads the chopping-block odds at 35%, with Purdy Good next at 27%.
🔭 Player to watch: Jaylen Warren (PIT VS NO). ESPN projects 17.95 pts, and Claremont In Yo Stace! is 48% against TDsMaGee.
🗓️ Another tight one Sunday: The Mahomies 65% vs Kyle Tucker. Kyle Tucker leads by 4.30 after TNF. Watch Chase (22.50 pts) vs Smith-Njigba (20.45 pts).
🚮 POINTS ABANDONED: Players 49er Faith-Fool has cut this season have scored 159.86 pts since, led by Maye (118.86 pts) and Borregales (41.00 pts).
🎲 The Mahomies is rolling with 2 kickers, just 2 healthy RBs and 2 defenses. It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 19% against Claremont In Yo Stace! — and won.
